subject: Third-wave connectors activation — phased API key issuance & term adjustment
messages:
From: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@acmehealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Expansion to three new projects — inventory attached

Hi Logan,

Following up from our last check-in — the product org has approved expanding Redwood usage into three additional internal projects (ClaimsConnector, PatientChat, and BillingAssist). High level asks:

- Additional API keys for three projects (dev + prod per project)
- Anticipated initial QPS: 60 p95 per project, with expectation to grow to ~200 p95 across all projects in 3 months
- We'd like to align on any term/commit changes given the increased consumption and discuss pricing for new production keys

Can you share a recommended rollout approach? We prefer a phased activation rather than all-at-once; also want to ensure governance so keys can be rotated per team.

Attached: acme_app_inventory.csv (project owners + environment map).

Thanks,
Tom Ellis
Head of Platform Integrations
Acme Health

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-03T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion to three new projects — inventory attached

Tom — thanks for the detail and the inventory. This is great and aligns with what we discussed on the call. Proposed high-level approach: 

1) Phase 0 (this week): Issue sandbox/dev API keys for all three projects so teams can start integration and run end-to-end tests. No quota charges.
2) Phase 1 (week 2): Staggered production activation — start with ClaimsConnector (project lead: Sarah M) for a 2-week pilot at current commit, monitor token usage and latency.
3) Phase 2 (week 4–6): Enable PatientChat and BillingAssist production keys once pilot metrics are green; enable prefix/KV caching by default for chat flows to control cost.

Terms/pricing: given expected uplift, recommend a modest commit increase and a 12-month amendment (adds predictability for both sides). Marissa and I can draft an amendment with tiered pricing that scales by token bands so you only pay more if usage materializes.

Action items I need from you:
- Confirm tech contact for each project (name + email + expected go-live window)
- Accept phased timeline above or propose a different cadence
- Any internal security checklist we should pre-check for private keys (IP allow-list, rotation window)

Cc'ing our internal leads for sizing, pricing, and onboarding. I'll follow up with a proposed amendment draft.

— Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-04T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: ACME — three-project expansion (asks + next steps)
Cc: 

Folks — forwarding Tom's note and the inventory. TL;DR: Acme wants 3 new projects onboarded with a phased activation. Key asks for the thread:

- Karthik: can you run a quick sizing + cost delta for the three projects based on the attached inventory and their stated QPS? We need an estimate for incremental monthly token spend at 60 p95 and at the projected 200 p95. Also confirm whether we should recommend enabling KV/prefix caching and which quantization profile makes sense for their chat models.

- Marissa: we should propose a 12-month amendment with a tiered commit. Can you prepare two pricing options — conservative (10% commit bump) and aggressive (25% bump with volume discounts) — and include lead time for legal sign-off?

- Monica: onboarding checklist + governance: propose per-project API key naming convention, rotation cadence (we usually recommend 90 days), and a one-page runbook for owners. Can you draft and include a sample key claim workflow so their platform team can self-serve?

Proposed timeline (subject to your inputs):
- Fri 4/9: Karthik posts sizing + ops notes
- Tue 4/13: Marissa posts pricing options + draft amendment outline
- Thu 4/15: Monica posts onboarding runbook + key governance template
- Week of 4/19: Issue sandbox keys; schedule pilot activation for ClaimsConnector week of 4/26

I'll coordinate with Tom and Natalie on their side. Flagging potential risk: if the pilot requests production keys earlier than week of 4/26, we'll need expedited legal and devops support.

Thanks — Logan

From: Natalie Ruiz <natalie.ruiz@acmehealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-06T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion to three new projects — inventory attached

Logan / team — appreciate the clear plan. Confirming we agree to the phased approach and the proposed timeline. Quick notes from our side: 

- Tech contacts: ClaimsConnector -> Sarah Mitchell <sarah.m@acmehealth.com> (pilot lead), PatientChat -> Diego Ramos <diego.r@acmehealth.com>, BillingAssist -> Priya Shah <priya.s@acmehealth.com>.
- We'd like the production keys for ClaimsConnector enabled no earlier than 4/26 and to keep the pilot at the current commit for two weeks as suggested.
- Our security team requests that rotation cadence be configurable per key and that we receive a short (1–2 page) audit of how token-level logs are retained; happy to share an internal SOC checklist.

I'm attaching a first-pass amendment_draft_v1.docx that reflects a 12-month term with a tiered commit increase. Marissa — if you can review with legal and suggest any language changes, that would be great.

Thanks — looking forward to the sandbox keys this week.

Best,
Natalie Ruiz
VP, Platform Engineering
Acme Health

Attachment: amendment_draft_v1.docx
